attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the cluster's internal chrony time server and node2 as its client via an Ansible playbook run from node3 (the Ansible-equipped control node). Fixed missing SSH host keys/sshd on node1 and node2 to enable Ansible connectivity, then applied /root/ansible-timesync/playbook.yml against inventory.ini. Verified node2 tracks node1 (not a public server) as its current best source. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot_id proof of restart and post-restart health/recovery verification.
